# aws-api-gateway

REST vs HTTP API differences that change findings: authorizers, payload format, throttling defaults, 29s integration timeout and pricing model.

## Rules

| Rule | Severity | Title |
|---|---|---|
| `AF-GW-001` | critical | No `authorizationType: NONE` method on production stages |
| `AF-GW-002` | high | Throttling is configured on every public stage |
| `AF-GW-003` | high | Access logging is enabled on every served stage |
| `AF-GW-004` | high | Public stages sit behind WAF |
| `AF-GW-005` | medium | Cache is opt-in per method with a stated TTL, never ambient |
| `AF-GW-006` | medium | Stages isolate environments — config drift is named |
| `AF-GW-007` | medium | `apiKeyRequired` is a quota tool, not authorization |
